verdict.rationale: Exporting account data is a fair question for a cloud agent service that keeps persistent memory, files, and sessions, so the axis applies. However, the evidence documents no data-export or account-portability feature. The CSV/JSON/YAML mention describes file types the Bot works with in results, not an export of the user's data, so it is an adjacent feature and earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave
